correctness.rationale: Complete powered-distance spectrum on the zero-sum hyperplane follows from generalized quadrangle incidence identities; multiplicities exhaust \(2v-1\). Strict inequalities exclude all other branches until \(p_0\); \(F_q\) has a unique positive root below \(p_0\) and failure is proved at every larger p. Endpoint kernel/rank and \(q^{-3}\) asymptotics are derived. Exact integer incidence and BFS checks plus independent numerical spectra are reproducible for prime orders 2,3,5.

value.rationale: The exact generalized-roundness endpoint is a natural all-orders metric invariant for a canonical, diameter-four distance-regular family. The one-dimensional equality kernel, exact critical Hilbert-rank drop and cubic asymptotic collapse are a structural phase law, not arbitrary finite tabulation or a renaming of a previously evaluated class.
